settings.heading: A membrane, sealed inside a knitted sock.

settings.heading: Measure the foot, not the shoe.
settings.lede: Shoe sizing is not consistent between brands. Foot length is, and it is the thing that actually has to fit inside the sock.

settings.title: Four bands
settings.body: S fits UK 3–5, M fits UK 6–8, L fits UK 9–11, XL fits UK 12–14. Each band is set by foot length in centimetres, published in full on the size guide.

settings.title: Between two bands
settings.body: Take the larger one. These are a close, stretchy fit, and a size down grips the toes and shortens the life of the membrane.

settings.title: Inside a boot or a cycling shoe
settings.body: They add roughly the bulk of a mid-weight sock. If your footwear is already tight with a thick sock, it will be tight with these.

settings.title: Washing them will not ruin them. Heat will.
settings.body: Cool wash, no fabric softener, no bleach, air dry. A membrane fails from heat, softener and abrasion long before it fails from age.

settings.title: Fourteen days, no reason needed.
settings.body: Unworn and in the original packaging. Your statutory rights are the floor here, not the ceiling — the returns page sets out both.

settings.title: A fault is not the same as wear.
settings.body: A seam that lets water through in the first weeks of normal use is a fault. Thinning at the heel after months is wear. The warranty page draws the line honestly.

settings.question: Do HydroSox come up big or small?
settings.answer: They run true to the foot-length bands published on the size guide, and they are a close, stretchy fit rather than a loose one. If you are between two bands, take the larger — a size down grips the toes and shortens the life of the membrane.

settings.question: Do HydroSox come in different heights?
settings.answer: No. One height, crew, in every colour and size. A single construction is the reason the price is £20 rather than £35.

settings.question: Are HydroSox suitable for women?
settings.answer: Yes. The bands run from UK 3, and the sock is unisex. Size on foot length rather than on the men's or women's label you are used to.

settings.question: How many pairs do most people buy?
settings.answer: Two or three. They need washing and air drying between wears, and air drying takes longer than a tumble dryer would, so one pair rarely keeps up with a daily problem.

settings.question: Can I wash HydroSox in a machine?
settings.answer: Cool wash, gentle cycle, inside out, no fabric softener and no bleach. Then air dry away from a radiator. Never tumble dry and never iron — both are heat applied directly to a laminate.

settings.question: What is included when I order?
settings.answer: The pairs you selected, in the colour and size you chose, and nothing else. No boxes, no printed inserts.
